entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: A paranoid viashino Izzet artificer of Ravnica, inventor of the projektors, killed during the Murders at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Kylox's friend, who investigates the case.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Investigator who came with Proft to Kylox.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Kylox's guildmaster in the Izzet League.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: Archon who enlisted Kylox for a secret project.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Criminal whose underlings ransacked Kylox's lab and kidnapped him.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Mastermind behind the killings, who justified Kylox's killing by his Phyrexian technology work.

entities.name: Murders at Karlov Manor
entities.description: The case in which Kylox was a victim.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Kylox noted Phyrexian designs.

events.summary: Kylox is enlisted by Ezrim for a secret project and moves it to a secret tunnel after his lab is ransacked by Krenko's underlings.
events.quote: Kylox was enlisted by the archon Ezrim for a project he was to keep secret

events.summary: Proft and Etrata ask Kylox to research a substance; he refuses without a promise of safety.
events.quote: Kylox turned them down unless they could promise him safety

events.summary: Krenko's minions kidnap Kylox; Proft and Etrata free him but a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko accidentally kills Kylox.
events.quote: he was accidentally killed by a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko

events.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the mastermind; Oba justifies Kylox's killing by his Phyrexian technology work.
events.quote: she justified Kylox's killing by blaming his work with Phyrexian technology

relations.quote: He was a friend of Alquist Proft 's
His guildmaster Ral Zarek considered him a good worker
Krenko's minions invaded the tunnel and kidnapped Kylox
